name: Anastasia Hoshin
japaneseName: アナスタシア・ホーシン
description: Anastasia Hoshin is the president of the Hoshin Company based in the Kararagi City-States and a candidate to become the 42nd monarch of Lugunica in the Royal Selection. She plays a major role in Arc 5, a supporting role in Arc 3, and a lesser supporting role in Arc 6 and Arc 8.
